deleteForMe.title: Delete this message for me?
deleteForMe.description: This message will be removed from your account only. Other participants will continue to see it.
deleteForMe.consequence1: This action cannot be undone from your account.
deleteForMe.consequence2: Other participants and their copies are not affected.
deleteForMe.consequence3: Shared attachment files remain available to authorized participants.

deleteForEveryone.title: Delete this message for everyone?
deleteForEveryone.description: The message content will be removed for conversation participants and replaced by the existing deleted-message state.
deleteForEveryone.consequence2: Separately forwarded copies remain available where authorized.
deleteForEveryone.consequence3: Attachment cleanup follows the existing storage-reference rules.

leaveGroup.title: Leave {{name}}?
leaveGroup.description: Your membership will end and you will stop receiving new messages from this group.
leaveGroup.consequence1: You may lose access to group-only actions and future content.
leaveGroup.consequence2: Existing history remains subject to the group history policy.
leaveGroup.consequence3: A group administrator must add you again if you need to rejoin.

deleteOfficialGroup.title: Delete official group {{name}}?
deleteOfficialGroup.description: This official messaging group will be permanently removed for every member.
deleteOfficialGroup.consequence1: The group's message history and linked group announcements will be removed.
deleteOfficialGroup.consequence2: The underlying organization, division, department and employee assignments remain unchanged.

deleteGroup.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteGroup.description: This personal group will be permanently removed for every member.
deleteGroup.consequence1: The group and its message history will no longer be available to participants.
deleteGroup.consequence2: Separately forwarded copies in other conversations remain available where authorized.

blockContact.title: Block {{name}}?
blockContact.description: Private messages and new private-message requests with this account will be blocked.
blockContact.consequence1: Official groups and announcements remain visible where authorized.
blockContact.consequence2: This does not remove the employee from organizational groups.
blockContact.consequence3: You can unblock the account later from Settings.
